name: Soave

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

keyfacts: Garganega is the principal grape, and Soave must contain a minimum of 70% Garganega.
Soave Superiore has been a DOCG since 2001, created for the 2002 vintage, and Recioto di Soave received its own DOCG in 1998.
Soave Classico comes from hillside vineyards around Soave and Monteforte d'Alpone, with limestone soils in the west and decomposed volcanic rock in the east.
Recioto di Soave uses the appassimento drying process and keeps much of its sweetness.
Soave Superiore Riserva needs a minimum alcohol of 12.5% and at least 24 months of ageing, with at least three months in bottle.

blurb.text: A dry white wine from the Veneto, made around Verona, with Garganega as the principal grape. Most is dry and still and some is sparkling, while sweet Recioto di Soave has its own DOCG.
